name: Alcohol
summary:
This can come in a variety of colors, aromas, and tastes, from the cheapest swill to the finest spiced wines.

This is a recreational poison used to lower inhibitions and clear minds, typically consumed at meals. Drinking in excess can cause migraines and lead to addiction.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 1 Hour
• Composition: Liquid (Ingested)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a make a Might Save. The DC equals 5 + 1 per drink consumed in the last hour. Failure: Target is Impaired for 1 hour. Failure (5): Target is also Dazed for the duration.

name: Assassin’s Poison
summary:
This can come in a variety of colors and viscosity, but frequently has a strong, acrid smell and taste.

These crude poisons are easy to make, but very low quality. They’re typically used by inexperienced rogues and assassins before they gain access to stronger poisons.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 1 Minute
• Composition: Any

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a DC 12 Might Save. Failure: Target takes 1 Poison damage at the start of its turn for 1 minute.

STRONGER VARIANTS
At higher levels, you can make slightly stronger variants of this poison by increasing the damage dealt to 2 or 3.

name: Blackout
summary:
This light gray liquid swirls like smoke and becomes colorless when it contacts food or water. It has a slightly floral fragrance and faintly sweet taste.

This poison is frequently used by criminals to obfuscate their crimes. It’s commonly mixed into Alcohol for plausible deniability and to pair with inhibiting effects of Alcohol.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 1 Hour
• Composition: Liquid (Ingested)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a DC 15 Might or Intelligence Save. Failure: 1 hour after consumption, the target forgets every detail about the previous hour. Failure (5): Target is also unaware that it’s missing memories.

name: Hallucinogen
summary:
This is either a beige powder that smells and tastes earthy or a gray smoke with an herbal and slightly acrid scent.

This is a recreational poison that is frequently used for group bonding or to strengthen one’s resolve. It’s also used in religious ceremonies to see past the material plane, gain insight, or strengthen spiritual connections. Prolonged use can have significant mental impacts.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 1 Hour
• Composition: Gas (Inhaled) or Powder (Ingested, Inhaled)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a make a DC 12 Might or Intelligence Save. Failure: Target has vivid hallucinations for 1 hour, granting it DisADV on Awareness Checks and a random secondary effect.

Roll a d6 to determine the secondary effect:
• 1: Target becomes Frightened of all creatures it can see.
• 2-3: Target becomes Intimidated by all creatures it can see.
• 4-5: Target is immune to being Intimidated.
• 6: Target is immune to being Frightened and Intimidated.

name: Sedative
summary:
A slightly yellow syrup smelling of alcohol with an earthy taste.

This cheap poison makes the target sluggish. It’s frequently used in fights to get the upper hand, but is also used to rig bets by drugging animals about to race.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 10 Minutes
• Composition: Liquid (Attack, Ingested)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a DC 15 Physical Save. Failure: Target is Impaired and Slowed for 10 minutes.

name: Sleep Powder
summary:
This white crystalline powder smells of lavender and tastes like jasmine tea when mixed with water.

One of the most common non-lethal poisons, this is often used to non-lethally subdue guards standing watch or when taking hostages.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 1 Minute
• Composition: Powder (Inhaled, Ingested)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a DC 14 Might or Charisma Save. Failure: Target falls Unconscious for 1 minute. Failure (5): The duration increases to 10 minutes.

The target regains consciousness if it’s damaged or an adjacent creature spends 1 AP to wake it up.

name: Creeping Death
summary:
This substance looks like charcoal laced with jade shavings that seems to dimly twinkle in even the faintest of light. If one listens closely, it sounds as if it’s being ground in a mortar and pestle at all times. It gives off a faint heat, as if from the friction of the endless grinding.

Corrupt politicians and nefarious wizards looking to weaken the defenses of a large group of people often use this poison against guard barracks or royal courts before an insurrection or coup. This substance slowly drains a creature it affects, leaving them more and more vulnerable the longer they’re under its influence.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: Indefinite
• Composition: Powder (Inhaled, Ingested)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a DC 20 Might Save. Failure: Target gains 1 stack of Doomed every hour until it’s cured.

name: Delayed Death
summary:
This thick, black sludge smells of rot and has a strong, bitter taste.

This poison is a slow death in liquid form. It was created to fell the most hardy of beasts with regenerative abilities, loading them up with poison that destroys them from their insides in a sudden burst. It has also been used on nobles to extort massive payments for the antidote.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 24 Hours
• Composition: Liquid (Attack, Ingested)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a DC 17 Might Save. Failure: Target is Impaired and Dazed for the duration. If the target is still affected by this Poison at the end of the duration, it repeats this Save. Failure: Target dies. Success: Target is reduced to 0 HP.

name: Laughing Gas
summary:
This colorless gas has a mildly minty scent.

This is known to be used by thieves to cause distractions and temporarily incapacitate pursuers. Sometimes, kids or immature adults use it for pranks, causing someone to fall over laughing at an inopportune moment.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 1 Minute
• Composition: Gas (Inhaled)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a DC 15 Repeated Might Save. Failure: Target is Prone and Incapacitated for 1 minute. The effect immediately ends if the target takes damage.

name: Marrowbane
summary:
This thick red paste smells like blood and has a deep, meaty flavor.

This is used to weaken the target’s bones, making them physically frail and easier to take down in combat. Prizefighters have been known to lace their opponents’ meals with this before a fight.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 1 Hour
• Composition: Liquid (Attack, Ingested)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a DC 16 Might Save. Failure: Target has DisADV on Might Checks and has Bludgeoning Vulnerability (2) for 1 hour.

name: Nerve Toxin
summary:
This pale yellow gel-like liquid or gas is odorless and flavorless.

This rare and exotic poison is very expensive and hard to come by. It’s particularly potent, leaving the target helpless for the duration and sometimes to die choking.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 1 Minute
• Composition: Liquid (Contact, Ingested) or Gas (Inhaled)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a DC 17 Repeated Physical Save. Failure: Target is Paralyzed for 1 minute. Critical Failure: Target is Suffocating for the duration.

name: Stunning Serum
summary:
This thin, yellow paste has a slight numbing effect on skin and no discernible smell.

A potent combat poison, this can debilitate a target preventing them from fighting back. It’s most used by experienced rogues and assassins when they need to fight or flee.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 1 Minute
• Composition: Liquid (Attack)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a DC 15 Repeated Might Save. Failure: Target is Stunned 1 for 1 minute. Failure (each 5): The target gains an additional stack of Stunned for the duration.

STRONGER VARIANTS
At higher levels, you can make slightly stronger variants of this poison by increasing the amount of Stunned applied to Stunned 2.

name: Trust Dust
summary:
This blue powder sparkles and smells different for each person, evoking an aroma of whatever brings comfort to the individual.

This poison is frequently used by criminals at the start of swindles and cons, typically with disguises in case the victim resists the poison and registers that something is off.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 10 Minutes
• Composition: Powder (Ingested, Inhaled)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a make a DC 16 Charisma Save. Failure: Target doesn’t know that it’s been Poisoned, has DisADV on Insight Checks, and Checks made by other creatures to influence the target are made with ADV for 10 minutes. Success: Target knows that it was a target of this poison.

name: Truth Serum
summary:
This clear, thin syrup has a slightly sweet taste and aroma.

This poison is frequently used in attempts to find turncoats, though due to its unreliability it’s rarely used for important matters. Due to its sweet taste and aroma, it needs to be masked in something strong or something that’s already sweet if administered covertly.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 10 Minutes
• Composition: Liquid (Ingested) or Gas (Inhaled)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a DC 16 Might or Charisma Save. Failure: Target is unable to lie for 10 minutes, but they’re not compelled to speak.

name: Veinfire
summary:
This purple tinted liquid emits a faint haze that looks like translucent flame. It has no taste or odor.

This causes a swift, intense fever as if the target’s blood was transfused with fire. Assassins using this poison frequently mix it with wine. Some nobles who’ve experienced hot flashes during a meal have claimed them to be failed assassination attempts.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 1 Minute
• Composition: Liquid (Attack, Ingested)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a DC 17 Repeated Might Save. Failure: Target takes 2 Fire damage and takes 1 Fire damage at the start of its turn for 1 minute. Success: Target takes 2 Fire damage.

name: Void Venom
summary:
This thick, black liquid absorbs all light and smells of burnt wood.

A particularly potent poison for thieves, this can be used to slip away from pursuers or create openings if they need to attack.
mechanics:
BETA NOTE
These examples are written during Beta 0.9.5 and are designed with Levels 1 to 4 in mind. GMs can always make these more deadly by increasing the Save DC or using the Stronger Variants heading at the bottom of an entry as guidance.

DETAILS
• Duration: 1 Minute
• Composition: Liquid (Attack)

When a target is afflicted by this Poison, it must make a DC 18 Repeated Might Save. Failure: Target is Blinded for 1 minute. Failure (5): Target is also Deafened for the duration.
